# CACIO Italian Bistro

> > Authentic Italian bistro in Sarasota, Florida specializing in Rome-style Cacio e Pepe, homemade pasta, and premium Italian ingredients.

CACIO is an authentic Italian restaurant founded by Lisa & Pietro, offering traditional Roman cuisine with house-made pasta, premium Wagyu beef, fresh seafood, and imported Italian ingredients. The bistro provides full-service catering for private events and specializes in classic dishes like Cacio e Pepe alongside carefully curated Italian wines.
